channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in United Kingdom
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Win a £4,000 Heidi and Salomon Ski Holiday Bundle – Ellis Brigham Mountain Sports
item.description: Prize: £2,000 Heidi ski-holiday credit plus £2,000 to spend on Salomon gear at Ellis Brigham. Deadline: November 5, 2026. Enter your details on the competition page; one entry per person. UK and Ireland residents 18+

item.title: Win £100 to spend at NIPO (Newcastle) – Appetite magazine
item.description: Prize: £100 voucher for food and drink at NIPO, Newcastle Quayside (use by 30 Dec 2026). Deadline: November 13, 2026. Fill in the competition form on the Appetite page. Free. Closing date Friday 13 November 2026; winner drawn at random

item.title: BOLIA Black Week competition: win your favourite design – BOLIA A/S
item.description: Prize: The most expensive design on your favourites list, worth up to £6,800. Deadline: November 19, 2026. Join MyBOLIA (free), create a favourites list called BW26 and save the designs you dream of. 18+, UK residents. Closes 19 November 2026

item.title: St Catherine's Hospice Christmas Hamper Prize Draw – St Catherine's Hospice (Preston)
item.description: Prize: A Christmas hamper (collect from the hospice near Preston, PR5 5XU). Deadline: November 20, 2026. Free entry: fill in the hospice's hamper prize draw entry form (no lottery ticket needed). 18+, Great Britain residents; prize must be collected in Lostock Hall, Preston. Closes 20 November 2026, 11:59pm

item.title: Your Holiday Concierge Package Perfect Giveaway: Win a White Company Advent Calendar – Your Holiday Concierge (Brewood)
item.description: Prize: The White Company Advent Calendar worth £336. Deadline: November 20, 2026. Complete the online competition form and answer a few short questions about your holiday habits. Free, no booking needed. 18+, UK residents. Closes 20 November 2026, 11:59pm

item.title: Lights4fun reindeer family competition – Lights4fun Ltd
item.description: Prize: A light-up reindeer family worth £384.99. Deadline: November 27, 2026. Enter via the competition form (joins the myLights4fun email club). Free, 18+. Closes 12pm on Friday 27 November 2026

item.title: Elf Watch November Prize Draw (GB) – Dubois Group Ltd (Elf Watch)
item.description: Prize: £1,000 first prize + 10 Elf Watch Season Passes. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Sign up to the free Elf Tracker on elf.watch and invite friends with your link; when 3 friends have started the tracker you are entered. No purchase or app needed, 18+. Closes 29 November 2026 (23:59 UK time)

item.title: Bond It GBX Prize Draw – Seal It Services Ltd (Bond It)
item.description: Prize: 13 prizes: £1,000, £500 and £250 cash plus 10 GBX/Bond It product bundles (~£50 each). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: complete the online entry form (a few optional market research questions). One entry per person, UK residents 18+. Closes 23:59 on 30 November 2026, draw by 7 December

item.title: Win a festive trip for a family of four to Battersea Power Station – Food and Travel Magazine
item.description: Prize: Festive trip for four worth £2,150: one night in a central London hotel plus Chimney Lift Experience, Glide ice rink and Ramses exhibition tickets. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Answer the question and fill in the form on the competition page. See full T&Cs for eligibility

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT

item.title: Watts Gallery Christmas competition: William Morris exhibition tickets + £100 shop voucher – Watts Gallery – Artists' Village
item.description: Prize: Two tickets to the Art of Wallpaper: Morris & Co exhibition and a £100 Watts Shop voucher. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Subscribe to the Watts Gallery newsletter using the form on the page. UK residents 18+. Closes 11.59pm on 1 December 2026; winner contacted 2 December

item.title: Flower & White Black Friday VIP giveaway: £500 in vouchers – Flower & White
item.description: Prize: £250 Secret Escapes voucher + £250 Love2shop voucher (£500 total), one winner. Deadline: December 2, 2026. Join the Black Friday VIP list via the sign-up form on the page. Free, one entry per person, UK residents 18+. Winner drawn 2 December 2026; page says entries until 6 December 2026

item.title: Wickedly Welsh Christmas Prize Draw 2026 – Wickedly Welsh Chocolate Limited
item.description: Prize: 5 × Wickedly Welsh Christmas bundle (advent calendar, bauble, Yule log, festive box; almost £50 each) or £50 credit. Deadline: December 19, 2026. Purchase required: every £10 spent on qualifying Wickedly Welsh products gives one automatic entry. 18+, mainland UK. Closes 19 December 2026; draw 21 December

item.title: B&M Pedigree & Dreamies Christmas Text to Win – Mars (Pedigree & Dreamies) at B&M
item.description: Prize: Cash prizes: 3 × £500, 1 × £150 and 1 × £100. Deadline: December 20, 2026. Purchase required: buy any Dreamies or Pedigree treat at B&M, then text XMASWIN to 81400 (standard network rate) and keep the receipt. One entry per person, GB 18+

item.title: Cartridge People Black Colourful Friday free daily prize draw – The Cartridge People Ltd
item.description: Prize: Seven daily prizes 23–29 Nov, incl. a Samsung Q7F 55" 4K TV, Shark Freestyle Max vacuum, Ninja coffee machine, Lenovo tablet, Cricut Explore 4 and Samsung Odyssey monitor + Brother scanner. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Free entry form on the Cartridge People Black Friday promotion page, once per day from 23 to 29 November 2026 (each day closes 23:59 GMT). No purchase necessary; orders also give an automatic entry. UK & Channel Islands residents 18+

item.title: bunkered Advent Calendar 2026 – bunkered (PSP Media Group)
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: a new golf prize competition every day, 1–24 December; prizes not listed on the page). 2025: click the day's door and enter that day's competition; each one stayed open until 23:59 on 31 December

item.title: Wanderlust Reader Travel Awards 2026 prize draw – Wanderlust Travel Media
item.description: Prize: Travel prizes worth about £80,000 in total (some prizes for select residents only). Deadline: October 27, 2026. Vote in the Wanderlust Reader Travel Awards and enter; follow Wanderlust on Instagram or Facebook (or be a subscriber). 18+

item.title: The Snowman 2026 Silver Proof Coin Prize Draw – The Royal Mint
item.description: Prize: 2026 The Snowman UK silver Proof colour coin in acrylic block (1 winner). Deadline: November 1, 2026. Enter your contact details in the form; 1 entry per household. UK residents 18+

item.title: Visit Cardiff Christmas Prize Draw – Visit Cardiff
item.description: Prize: Cardiff Christmas break: 2 nights at Hotel Indigo (4–6 Dec 2026), Winter Wonderland skating, Cardiff Castle tickets, dining and more. Deadline: November 1, 2026. Enter your details on the page; 1 entry per person. UK residents 18+

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: LEGO Win Your Wish List – LEGO
item.description: Prize: Your LEGO wish list worth up to £1,000 (2 winners). Deadline: November 22, 2026. Join LEGO Insiders for free and enter once. 18+, no purchase necessary

item.title: Flipz 'Grab a Grand' 2026 – pladis (Flipz)
item.description: Prize: 12 × £1,000 (weekly draws) and a £2,000 bonus draw. Deadline: November 23, 2026. Buy a promo pack of Flipz and enter the batch code/barcode; max 1 per day, 2 per week. UK & ROI 18+. Late bonus draw runs to 31 Dec

item.title: Winalot: win a set visit to All Creatures Great and Small – Purina (Winalot)
item.description: Prize: 3-night 4* hotel stay in Harrogate for 2 with a visit to the filming set. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter your details on purina.co.uk/brands/winalot/2026-competition. UK, Channel Islands and Isle of Man residents 18+

item.title: Royal Collection Shop Christmas Hamper competition – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details; one entry per person. Free, postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026 23:59 GMT

item.title: Win a £250 Welsh food and drink hamper – What's On Ynys Môn
item.description: Prize: £250 Welsh food and drink hamper. Deadline: December 13, 2026. Sign up to the free weekly email, or enter by emailing hello@whatsonynysmon.co.uk. UK residents 18+

item.title: Win an ASH Christmas Kitchen Bundle – ASH Chopping Boards
item.description: Prize: Handmade ash chopping board, oak cheese board and board butter (worth almost £100). Deadline: December 13, 2026. Enter on the page; one entry per person. UK residents, free

item.title: Captain's Fare Norwegian Fjords Cruise Prize Draw – Captain's Fare (Model Tourism Ltd)
item.description: Prize: 7-night balcony cruise for two, Southampton to the Norwegian Fjords in 2027. Deadline: December 24, 2026. Join the waiting list and confirm your email (or enter by email). One entry per person. UK 18+, free

item.title: FTP Year of Fuel Prize Draw – FTP Endurance Fuel
item.description: Prize: 8 Power Endurance System boxes, one every 6 weeks (£559.92). Deadline: December 30, 2026. Free entry: email support@ftpendurancefuel.com with subject "Year of Fuel draw", your name and postcode, 1 per day. Orders also count. UK 18+

item.title: Win a Park Holidays holiday home – Park Holidays UK
item.description: Prize: 3-bedroom holiday home worth up to £60,000, pitch fees for the season, decking and £10,000 to spend. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the entry form; one entry per address. UK 18+; existing Park Holidays owners cannot enter

item.title: Win a Food Lover's Break in Northumberland – Visit Northumberland
item.description: Prize: Night for two at The Tempus with dinner and breakfast + "Meet the Makers" food tour for two. Deadline: January 31, 2027. Fill in the form on the page; 1 entry per person, 18+

item.title: Visit Lake District Christmas prize draws – Visit Lake District
item.description: Prize: A new Cumbrian prize draw every day (prizes revealed daily). Deadline: December 24, 2026. Come back each day from 1 December and enter that day’s free prize draw

item.title: 24 Days of DHL Virtual Advent Calendar 2026 – Deutsche Post DHL
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+

item.title: Dr. Oetker Advent Calendar 2026 – Dr. Oetker (UK)
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: 24 daily prizes, including Love2Shop vouchers of £20–£100). 2025: fill in the form behind each day's door and complete the quiz/game. One entry per person per day, UK 18+

item.title: London Heritage Quarter Online Advent Calendar 2026 – London Heritage Quarter
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: a daily prize from local businesses). 2025: one entry per person per daily prize, 00:01–23:59 on the day. UK residents 18+, no purchase necessary

item.title: The English Home 12 Days of Christmas Giveaways 2026 – The English Home (Chelsea Magazine Company)
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: 12 separate home and interiors prize draws). 2025: enter each of the 12 online prize draws on the page. UK residents 18+

item.title: UKCampsite Advent Calendar Giveaway 2026 – UKCampsite.co.uk
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: 24 daily camping prizes such as tents, Cadac cookers and Cobb BBQs, plus an Anker SOLIX C1000 power station as the Christmas Day star prize). 2025: open each day's window to be entered automatically; each day also adds an entry for the star prize. UK residents only
